defaultConfig.heroMessage: Today is entirely yours. A whole little sanctuary of wishes — for every laugh we’ve shared, every quiet late-night talk, and every reason you make this world softer, warmer, and so much brighter.
defaultConfig.wish1Body: Your laugh is pure medicine. Wishing you a year bursting with spontaneous giggles and untamed joy.
defaultConfig.wish2Body: You remember the tiny details that nobody else notices. May that same tenderness wrap around your heart every day.
defaultConfig.wish3Body: May this upcoming chapter bring peaceful mornings, delicious dinners, big dreams realized, and boundless love.
defaultConfig.letterBody:
There is no greeting card in the world large enough to hold everything I’d love to tell you today, so I built this little garden for you instead — with your favorite melody, memories that make me smile, and wishes straight from the heart.

Thank you for the quiet, unseen gestures — the random texts on tough days, the silly inside jokes only we understand, and the effortless way you bring comfort wherever you go. I noticed. I always notice.

I hope that today, you feel deeply cherished. Eat your favorite cake, dance without caring who is watching, and know that you are endlessly loved.

May this new trip around the sun bring you the purest magic.
